content: रौद्र {%a.%} (-द्रा, -द्री|{%f.%}) [रुद्र-अण्] .²1 ‘Rudra-like’, violent, irascible, wrathful. .²2 Fierce, savage, terrible, wild. .²3 Addressed to Rudra (as a hymn). .²4 Bringing misfortune, calamitous. .²5 Relating to Rudra; रौद्रं व्रतं समास्थाय नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः <ls>Rām. 7. 13. 21</ls>. .{@-द्रः@} .²1 A worshipper of Rudra. .²2 Heat, ardour, warmth, passion, wrath. .²3 The sentiment of wrath or furiousness; रौद्रः क्रोधस्थायिभावो रक्तो रुद्राधिदैवतः <ls>S. D. 232</ls> or <ls>K. P. 4</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Yama. .²5 Winter. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a संवत्सर. .{@-द्रम्@} .²1 Wrath, rage. .²2 Formidableness, fierceness, savageness. .²3 Heat, warmth; solar heat.
